narrative.overview:
The page is a freshly finished room. Deep logo green and dry joint-compound white take turns as the ground, each section joined to the next by a moving skim-coat edge, and the gold taping knife from the owner's logo is the only thing that works on the page. The hero holds one live drywall wall: paper tape over the seams, screw dimples down the studs, and the knife skimming wet grey mud that dries to the page's own white. Everything outside that wall is quiet: heavy uppercase headings, plain first-person copy, flat grounds, and physical objects (photos, tape) only where the trade would have them.

The world is joint compound skimmed over taped drywall seams: paper tape, screw dimples, wet mud drying to flat white, feathered knife edges. Photos are taped up with the same paper joint tape. The system is phone-first and built for Facebook's in-app browser; desktop is the phone layout given more room, never a different site.
keyCharacteristics: Two grounds only, strictly alternating: logo green and dry mud white.
One signature interaction (the hero wall); every other surface is still or barely moving.
Heavy (900) uppercase display in the system sans; no display webfont.
Gold is the knife: it marks the primary action and answers hover, it is not decoration.
Depth belongs to physical objects pinned to the wall, never to sections or panels.

rules.name: The Knife Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold is the knife. It fills the primary action, numbers the steps, and answers a pointer; it never tints a section ground, a border at rest, or a body paragraph.

rules.name: The Deep Gold on Mud Rule
rules.body: Bright `gold` lives on green. On mud and fresh-coat surfaces, any gold line or outline uses `gold-deep`.

rules.name: The System Stack Rule
rules.body: Every pitch site uses the system font stack by the owner-designer's mandate. Weight 900 and uppercase do the display work; do not add a webfont without that mandate changing.

rules.name: The Upright Accent Rule
rules.body: Emphasis inside a heading is a color change to gold, never italic or a second family.

rules.name: The Alternating Coat Rule
rules.body: Section grounds alternate strictly: green hero, mud services, green steps, mud work, green area, mud estimate, night-green footer. A new section takes the opposite ground of the one above it.

rules.name: The Skim Edge Rule
rules.body: Every section after the hero opens with a 28px skim-coat edge: an SVG wave filled with that section's own ground, overlapping the section above by 27px. It is a smooth swept curve, never a torn or zigzag line.

rules.name: The Header Contact Rule
rules.body: The contact action sits in the header, top right, opposite the brand. There is no sticky bottom bar and no floating contact button.

rules.name: The Pinned Object Rule
rules.body: A shadow means something is physically fixed to the wall. Sections, text, rows, form fields and the sent panel never cast one.

rules.name: The Hand-Hung Rule
rules.body: Pinned photos are always slightly rotated and always held by two strips of tape. Nothing else on the page is rotated.

rules.name: The Arrow-Only Rule
rules.body: A service row never gains an outline, box, background or shadow on hover or focus. The arrow disc carries the entire state; the row text and rules stay put.

rules.name: The No Caption Rule
rules.body: Pinned photos carry no visible caption, label or overlay; descriptions live in alt text and aria-labels only.

rules.name: The Footer Email Rule
rules.body: An email address may appear only in the footer, and only once the business publishes one. None exists, so none is shown.

rules.name: The Still Frame Rule
rules.body: Under reduced motion the wall renders one still picture (the horizontal seam finished and dry, the knife resting on the vertical seam), the edges draw once and stop, the clip shows controls instead of autoplaying, and transforms and smooth scrolling are removed. Colors may still change state.

rules.name: The Off-Screen Rule
rules.body: Nothing animates off screen. The wall pauses when out of view or the tab is hidden, each edge animates only while intersecting, and the clip pauses when scrolled away.

dos: **Do** alternate green and mud grounds and open every new section with a skim-coat edge in its own ground color.
**Do** keep the contact action in the header, top right.
**Do** use `gold-deep` for any gold line, border or outline on mud or fresh-coat surfaces.
**Do** hold every photo up with two strips of joint tape, slightly rotated, with no caption.
**Do** keep form inputs at 17px or larger and controls at 44px or taller.
**Do** give every new animation a reduced-motion still frame and an off-screen pause.
donts: **Don't** add a sticky bottom bar or floating contact button.
**Don't** show an email anywhere but the footer, and never an invented one.
**Don't** add captions, labels or overlays to photos.
**Don't** outline, box, fill or shadow a service row on hover or focus; the arrow disc carries the state.

**Don't** use gold as decoration at rest on interactive elements in light sections; on mud it appears as a hover or focus response (the gold "Open Messenger" button is the one resting gold action there).
**Don't** add a second interactive or animated set piece; the wall is the only one.
**Don't** put shadows on sections, panels, rows or fields.
**Don't** add a display webfont or italic emphasis.
